question_summary: Contractor requests interim direction on an undersized mechanical shaft in the corridor chase near P-101 so work can continue while a permanent resolution is finalized, and asks whether the affected adjacent duct run needs a separate bulletin.
deadline_text: A response Friday would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: This is a field condition conflict with local schedule impact and urgent priority, so per policy rule 3 it is routed to the GC Superintendent to manage interim field direction while the design team issues a bulletin.
